problem_statement: Calculate income tax for a given income based on these rules: First $10,000: 0% tax. Next $10,000: 10% tax. Remaining income: 20% tax. Given Input: income = 45000. Expected Output: Total income tax to pay is 6000.

dimensions.name: Correctness
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates whether the algorithm's logic accurately applies the tax rules to calculate the correct tax for any valid income, ensuring all calculations are mathematically sound.
sub_criteria: Accurately calculates 0% tax on the first $10,000 portion of income.
Accurately calculates 10% tax on the next $10,000 portion of income (between $10,000 and $20,000 total income).
Accurately calculates 20% tax on any income portion exceeding $20,000.
Correctly sums the calculated tax amounts from all applicable brackets to determine the total tax.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.description: This dimension assesses if all necessary algorithmic components are present, including the input, and if the solution covers all specified tax brackets and income ranges.
sub_criteria: Accepts income as an input for the calculation.
Includes logic to determine tax for income up to the first tax bracket threshold ($10,000).
Includes logic to determine tax for income extending into the second tax bracket (between $10,000 and $20,000).
Includes logic to determine tax for income extending into the third tax bracket (above $20,000).

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates the readability and understandability of the pseudocode, focusing on clear variable names, logical flow, and step descriptions.
sub_criteria: Uses clear and descriptive names for variables representing income and tax amounts.
Describes the steps for calculating tax within each bracket in an easy-to-understand manner.
The overall sequence of operations for tax calculation is straightforward to follow.

dimensions.name: Efficiency
dimensions.description: This dimension evaluates if the algorithm avoids unnecessary computations or redundant steps, demonstrating an awareness of computational performance.
sub_criteria: Avoids redundant calculations of tax portions for the same income amount.
Processes the income through the tax brackets in a logical flow that minimizes re-evaluation or unnecessary passes.
